description: This file defines the ShippingService interface, outlining various methods for handling shipping configurations, calculations, and retrievals in an e-commerce platform.

classes.name: ShippingService
classes.description: Interface defining methods for managing shipping configurations, quotes, and options within the platform.

methods.name: getSupportedCountries
methods.description: Retrieves a list of countries supported for shipping for the specified merchant store.

methods.name: setSupportedCountries
methods.description: Sets the list of supported country codes for shipping on the merchant store.

methods.name: getShippingMethods
methods.description: Fetches the list of available shipping modules for the store.

methods.name: getShippingModulesConfigured
methods.description: Returns the configured shipping modules for the merchant store.

methods.name: saveShippingQuoteModuleConfiguration
methods.description: Saves configuration for a specific shipping quote module.

methods.name: getShippingConfiguration
methods.description: Retrieves the shipping configuration for the store.

methods.name: saveShippingConfiguration
methods.description: Saves the provided shipping configuration for the merchant store.

methods.name: removeShippingQuoteModuleConfiguration
methods.description: Removes the configuration of a specific shipping quote module.

methods.name: getPackagesDetails
methods.description: Provides detailed information on shipping packages based on products for the store.

methods.name: getShippingQuote
methods.description: Obtains shipping quotes based on products and delivery details.

methods.name: getCustomShippingConfiguration
methods.description: Retrieves custom configuration for a specific shipping module.

methods.name: saveCustomShippingConfiguration
methods.description: Saves custom configuration for a specified shipping module.

methods.name: removeCustomShippingQuoteModuleConfiguration
methods.description: Removes a custom shipping quote module configuration.

methods.name: getShippingSummary
methods.description: Creates a summary of shipping details based on the selected shipping option and quote.

methods.name: getShipToCountryList
methods.description: Returns a list of countries available for shipping to for a store, considering national or international shipping.

methods.name: requiresShipping
methods.description: Determines whether shipping should be proposed to the customer based on cart items.
